title: Hire a pro
subtitle: Post a job, pros send quotes, you pick the one you like

trade_hint.cleaning: Room, house, AC and workshop cleaning
trade_hint.welding: Gates, steel frames, metal roofs, fabrication
trade_hint.hvac: Repair, gas refill, cleaning for AC and fridges
trade_hint.other: Any other job that needs a hand

home.hero_title: Need a pro? Post a job and get quotes
home.hero_body: Free. Compare prices, pick the pro you like, then chat directly.
home.pro_hint: Are you a pro? Browse requests near you and send quotes.

list.title: Jobs near you
list.empty_body: Try another trade or area, or post your own request.

form.title: Title
form.title_placeholder: e.g. Fix a shorting socket in my room
form.description_placeholder: What's wrong, which device, when you're free… Don't write phone numbers — chat in the app.
form.photos_hint: Up to {{max}} photos help pros quote more accurately.
form.address_private: The exact address is only shown to the pro you choose. Everyone else sees an approximate area.
form.edit_locked: This request already has quotes, so its content can no longer be edited.
form.success_body: Pros near you will send quotes. You'll be notified when a new quote arrives.

detail.title: Request details
detail.address_hidden: The exact address appears once the owner chooses you.
detail.no_quotes_body: Pros near you will quote soon. You'll be notified right away.
detail.safety_body: Only communicate in the app and never pay before the work is done. If something feels wrong, report it.

quote.note_placeholder: e.g. I have my own tools, about 1 hour, 1-month warranty. Don't write phone numbers.
quote.withdraw_body: The owner will no longer see your quote. You can send it again while the request is open.
quote.accept_body: Other quotes will be declined and you'll chat with this pro. The exact address is shared with them.
quote.accepted_toast: Pro chosen — send a message to set a time

actions.cancel_body: Pros who quoted will be notified. This can't be undone.
actions.complete_body: After you confirm, you and the pro can rate each other.

rate.hint: Your rating helps others choose people they can trust.

mine.title: Mine
mine.empty_requests_body: Need electrical, plumbing, AC repair or cleaning? Post a request so pros can quote.
mine.empty_quotes_body: Browse requests near you and send quotes to win jobs.

chat.closed: This request is closed. You can still read the messages.
